name: TileShift
description: Gen 3 world art for Gen 1/2, with selectable trees, flowers, grass and animated water. Complete backgrounds across every Red, Blue and Yellow map and all Johto areas in Gold, Silver and Crystal. Native-scale buildings preserve complete frames and source entrances; Pokemon Centers offer Compact/Expanded designs. Original layouts, collision, scripts and interactions stay unchanged. Unique objects without a suitable counterpart retain their original pixels in matching Gen3 colors.
